title: A Ring Under Europe Is Colder Than Outer Space

scenes.text: A ring under Europe is colder than outer space.
Outer space sits at about minus 270.5 degrees Celsius.
The Large Hadron Collider's magnets run at minus 271.3.
About 120 tonnes of liquid helium keep them there.
That cold lets the magnets carry current with no resistance, steering protons around a 27 kilometre ring.
Humans built a place colder than the sky above it.

description:
The magnets of the Large Hadron Collider run at 1.9 kelvin, about minus 271.3 degrees Celsius, colder than the 2.7 kelvin of outer space.
About 120 tonnes of helium keep more than a thousand magnets superconducting around the 27 kilometre ring.
What is the coldest place you have ever been? Comment below.
first_comment: Outer space is warmed slightly by leftover radiation from the Big Bang, which is why a machine can beat it. Would you visit CERN if you could?
